title.en: How to Verify Consistency of Probabilistic Claims

title.en: How to Verify Probabilistic Consistency of Predictive Models

note.en: Bengio co-authors a theoretical AI-safety paper on efficiently verifying whether a probabilistic model's answers to conditional-probability queries are self-consistent.
note.zh: 本吉奥合著一篇AI安全理论论文，研究如何高效验证概率模型对条件概率查询的回答是否自洽。

title.zh: Adaptive Order Policies for Masked Diffusion

note.en: Bengio endorses a call likening AI to nuclear energy, arguing decisions on the technology must stay tied to conscience and responsibility.
note.zh: 本吉奥赞同将AI比作核能的观点,认为相关技术决策须始终与良知和责任相联系。

title.zh: I was happy to join the @ScienceBoard_UN podcast to discuss deception among frontier AI models and the need to manage its potential global impacts and risks.

note.zh: 本吉奥讲述参加Science Board UN播客,探讨前沿AI模型中的欺骗行为及其全球影响。

title.en: Generative Recursive Reasoning
title.zh: Generative Recursive Reasoning

note.en: With Sungjin Ahn and Mengye Ren, proposes recursive reasoning models as an alternative to autoregressive sequence extension for extended computation at inference time.
note.zh: 与 Sungjin Ahn、Mengye Ren 合作，提出以递归推理模型替代自回归序列延展，作为推理阶段延长计算的一种方案。

title.en: Interpretable epistemic uncertainty decomposition in sequential generative models via polynomial chaos surrogates
title.zh: Interpretable epistemic uncertainty decomposition in sequential generative models via polynomial chaos surrogates

note.en: Co-authored paper decomposing epistemic uncertainty in sequential generative models using polynomial chaos surrogate methods.
note.zh: 合著论文提出用多项式混沌代理方法分解序列生成模型中的认知不确定性。

title.en: When AI Learns To Lie (w/ Yoshua Bengio & Charlotte Stix)
title.zh: When AI Learns To Lie (w/ Yoshua Bengio & Charlotte Stix)

note.en: Discussed AI deception with policy expert Charlotte Stix on Science Forward, the podcast of the UN Secretary-General's Scientific Advisory Board.
note.zh: 在联合国秘书长科学咨询委员会播客Science Forward中，与政策专家Charlotte Stix探讨AI的欺骗行为问题。

title.zh: I sat down with @JonHernandezIA in Madrid to discuss the growing risks and impacts of AI and the urgent need to improve our social, political, and technical saf

note.en: Bengio describes a Madrid conversation on AI's growing risks and the need for stronger social, political and technical safeguards.
note.zh: 本吉奥描述在马德里的一次对话,探讨AI日益增长的风险及加强社会、政治与技术保障的必要性。

title.zh: Excellent explainer video by @FryRsquared on the risks of AI agents. She also raises a crucial point: we shouldn’t make the mistake of thinking current limitati

note.en: Bengio praises Hannah Fry's explainer on AI agent risks and stresses that current capability limitations should not be assumed to persist.
note.zh: 本吉奥称赞Hannah Fry关于AI智能体风险的解说视频,并强调不应假设当前能力局限会一直持续。

title.zh: Thank you to @robertwiblin for inviting me on the @80000Hours podcast to discuss the research progress we’re making at @LawZero_ to create safe-by-design AI sys

note.en: Bengio thanks Rob Wiblin for hosting him on the 80,000 Hours podcast to discuss LawZero's progress on safe-by-design AI systems.
note.zh: 本吉奥感谢Rob Wiblin邀请他上80000 Hours播客,介绍LawZero在设计即安全AI系统上的研究进展。

title.en: #243 – 'Godfather of AI' Yoshua Bengio: "I now see a path" to safe superintelligent AI
title.zh: #243 – 'Godfather of AI' Yoshua Bengio: "I now see a path" to safe superintelligent AI

note.en: A long-form 80,000 Hours interview where Bengio sets out his claim to have found a path to superintelligent AI that is honest and incapable of deception.
note.zh: 在 80,000 Hours 的长篇访谈中，Bengio 阐述了他所主张的通往诚实、无法欺骗的超级智能的路径。

title.zh: Thank you @UN Secretary General @antonioguterres for an excellent discussion on the current state of AI capabilities, and the urgent need for robust global gove

note.en: Bengio recounts a discussion with UN Secretary-General António Guterres on AI capabilities and the need for robust global governance.
note.zh: 本吉奥讲述与联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯就AI能力及强化全球治理必要性的讨论。

title.en: A Recurrent Latent Variable Model for Sequential Data
title.zh: A Recurrent Latent Variable Model for Sequential Data

note.en: Co-author of the influential Variational Recurrent Neural Network (VRNN) paper, which introduced latent variables into recurrent generative models for sequential data.
note.zh: 合著提出变分循环神经网络（VRNN）的重要论文，将潜变量引入序列数据的循环生成模型。

title.en: When 2D Tasks Meet 1D Serialization: On Serialization Friction in Structured Tasks
title.zh: When 2D Tasks Meet 1D Serialization: On Serialization Friction in Structured Tasks

note.en: Measures the cost that flattening natively two-dimensional problems into 1D text imposes on language models.
note.zh: 量化了把本质上二维的问题压平为一维文本时，语言模型所付出的代价。

title.zh: Safety and innovation are not mutually exclusive: for many companies, especially in high-trust industries, AI’s risks are also a hindrance to adoption. In this

note.en: Bengio's Financial Times op-ed argues safety and innovation are not mutually exclusive, and that AI risk hinders adoption in high-trust industries.
note.zh: 本吉奥在《金融时报》的专栏文章中指出,安全与创新并非对立,AI风险正阻碍高信任行业的采纳。

title.en: AI is advancing faster than our ability to manage it. We still have the opportunity to build the societal and technical guardrails we need to keep people, insti
title.zh: AI is advancing faster than our ability to manage it. We still have the opportunity to build the societal and technical guardrails we need to keep people, insti

note.en: Bengio warns AI is advancing faster than our ability to manage it and calls for building societal and technical guardrails while there's still time.
note.zh: 本吉奥警告AI发展速度已超出人类管控能力,呼吁抓紧时机建立社会和技术护栏。

title.zh: I’m in Madrid this week for the first in-person meeting of the United Nations Independent International Scientific Panel on AI. I'm thrilled to be part of this

note.en: Bengio reports attending the first in-person meeting in Madrid of the UN's Independent International Scientific Panel on AI.
note.zh: 本吉奥报告在马德里出席联合国AI独立国际科学小组的首次线下会议。

title.en: Je suis passé à Découverte de @CBCRadioCanada pour discuter des risques de l’IA, des raisons scientifiques qui expliquent certains des comportements inquiétants
title.zh: Je suis passé à Découverte de @CBCRadioCanada pour discuter des risques de l’IA, des raisons scientifiques qui expliquent certains des comportements inquiétants

note.en: Bengio recounts appearing on CBC Radio-Canada's Découverte to discuss AI risks and the science behind concerning model behaviors.
note.zh: 本吉奥讲述在CBC Radio-Canada的Découverte节目中探讨AI风险及令人担忧的模型行为背后的科学原因。

title.en: Language models recognize dropout and Gaussian noise applied to their activations
title.zh: Language models recognize dropout and Gaussian noise applied to their activations

note.en: Shows that language models can detect, localise and partly verbalise perturbations applied to their own activations — an interpretability result with direct bearing on monitoring.
note.zh: 证明语言模型能够检测、定位并在一定程度上用语言描述施加于自身激活值的扰动，这一可解释性结果对模型监控具有直接意义。

title.en: Local Inconsistency Resolution: The Interplay between Attention and Control in Probabilistic Models
title.zh: Local Inconsistency Resolution: The Interplay between Attention and Control in Probabilistic Models

note.en: A general learning and inference algorithm that repeatedly focuses on part of a probabilistic model and resolves its inconsistencies, giving attention an epistemic reading.
note.zh: 提出一种通用的学习与推断算法，反复聚焦于概率模型的局部并消解其中的不一致，为注意力机制赋予了认知论上的解释。

title.en: I went on @BBCNewsnight this week to discuss the recent developments in AI's capabilities, as well as the potential harms and concentration of power they could
title.zh: I went on @BBCNewsnight this week to discuss the recent developments in AI's capabilities, as well as the potential harms and concentration of power they could

note.en: Bengio recounts appearing on BBC Newsnight to discuss AI's recent capability gains and risks of harm and power concentration.
note.zh: 本吉奥讲述在BBC Newsnight节目中探讨AI近期能力提升及其带来的危害与权力集中风险。

title.en: Today, our group at @Mila_Quebec and the lab of @francesarnold at @Caltech just released a new paper I contributed to, exploring how multimodal generative model
title.zh: Today, our group at @Mila_Quebec and the lab of @francesarnold at @Caltech just released a new paper I contributed to, exploring how multimodal generative model

note.en: Bengio announces a new paper with Frances Arnold's Caltech lab exploring how multimodal generative modeling could accelerate protein science.
note.zh: 本吉奥宣布与Frances Arnold位于加州理工的实验室合作发表新论文,探讨多模态生成建模如何加速蛋白质科学研究。

title.en: General Multimodal Protein Design Enables DNA-Encoding of Chemistry
title.zh: General Multimodal Protein Design Enables DNA-Encoding of Chemistry

note.en: A multimodal generative model for protein design, co-authored with Frances Arnold and Alexander Tong, extending the chemistry that DNA can be made to encode.
note.zh: 与 Frances Arnold、Alexander Tong 合作提出的多模态蛋白质设计生成模型，拓展了 DNA 可编码的化学空间。

title.en: A Comparative Study of Molecular Dynamics Approaches for Simulating Ionic Conductivity in Solid Lithium Electrolytes
title.zh: A Comparative Study of Molecular Dynamics Approaches for Simulating Ionic Conductivity in Solid Lithium Electrolytes

note.en: A Mila–NRC benchmark of molecular-dynamics methods for predicting ionic conductivity in solid lithium electrolytes, part of Bengio's AI-for-materials work with Alex Hernandez-Garcia.
note.zh: Mila 与加拿大国家研究委员会合作，对预测固态锂电解质离子电导率的分子动力学方法进行基准评测，属于 Bengio 与 Alex Hernandez-Garcia 的 AI 材料研究。

title.en: AI can lie, hack and blackmail: Yoshua Bengio on how to tame the "baby tiger" of tech
title.zh: AI can lie, hack and blackmail: Yoshua Bengio on how to tame the "baby tiger" of tech

note.en: On the World Economic Forum's Radio Davos, Bengio describes the deceptive and coercive behaviour already visible in frontier models and what regulation would have to do about it.
note.zh: 在世界经济论坛的 Radio Davos 节目中，Bengio 描述了前沿模型已显现的欺骗与胁迫行为，以及监管应如何应对。

title.en: The Silent Thought: Modeling Internal Cognition in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models via Latent Reasoning
title.zh: The Silent Thought: Modeling Internal Cognition in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models via Latent Reasoning

note.en: Adds latent reasoning to full-duplex spoken dialogue models so they can think while listening; Bengio is senior author on the NTU collaboration.
note.zh: 为全双工语音对话模型加入隐式推理，使其能够边听边思考；Bengio 在这项与南洋理工大学的合作中担任通讯作者。

title.en: Noticing the Watcher: LLM Agents Can Infer CoT Monitoring from Blocking Feedback
title.zh: Noticing the Watcher: LLM Agents Can Infer CoT Monitoring from Blocking Feedback

note.en: Shows that LLM agents can work out they are under chain-of-thought monitoring purely from being blocked, which weakens CoT monitoring as an oversight method.
note.zh: 证明大模型智能体仅凭行动被拦截就能推断出自己正处于思维链监控之下，这削弱了思维链监控作为监督手段的可靠性。

title.en: Stuart Russell and Yoshua Bengio on Why AI Could Make us Irrelevant, then Extinct
title.zh: Stuart Russell and Yoshua Bengio on Why AI Could Make us Irrelevant, then Extinct

note.en: A joint appearance with Stuart Russell on the alignment problem and the argument that fixed-objective superintelligent systems could make humans irrelevant.
note.zh: 与 Stuart Russell 共同出镜，讨论对齐问题，以及固定目标的超级智能系统可能使人类变得无关紧要这一论点。

title.en: International AI Safety Report 2026
title.zh: International AI Safety Report 2026

note.en: The 2026 edition of the International AI Safety Report, which Bengio chairs and leads as first author, synthesising the evidence on general-purpose AI capabilities and risks for the governments that mandated it.
note.zh: 由 Bengio 主持并作为第一作者领衔的《2026 国际人工智能安全报告》，为委托各国政府系统梳理通用人工智能能力与风险方面的科学证据。

title.en: The Race to Build God: AI's Existential Gamble — Yoshua Bengio & Tristan Harris at Davos
title.zh: The Race to Build God: AI's Existential Gamble — Yoshua Bengio & Tristan Harris at Davos

note.en: Bengio and Tristan Harris in conversation at Davos on the competitive race to build superintelligence and the gamble it represents.
note.zh: Bengio 与 Tristan Harris 在达沃斯对谈，讨论建造超级智能的竞赛，以及这场竞赛所包含的赌注。

title.en: When Benign Inputs Lead to Severe Harms: Eliciting Unsafe Unintended Behaviors of Computer-Use Agents
title.zh: When Benign Inputs Lead to Severe Harms: Eliciting Unsafe Unintended Behaviors of Computer-Use Agents

note.en: With Dawn Song and Huan Sun, shows that computer-use agents can be driven into unsafe unintended behaviour by inputs that are themselves entirely benign.
note.zh: 与 Dawn Song、Huan Sun 合作，证明完全无害的输入也可能诱使计算机操作智能体产生不安全的非预期行为。

title.en: Synthesizable Molecular Generation via Soft-constrained GFlowNets with Rich Chemical Priors
title.zh: Synthesizable Molecular Generation via Soft-constrained GFlowNets with Rich Chemical Priors

note.en: Applies GFlowNets — the generative-search framework Bengio originated — to designing drug-like molecules that can actually be synthesised.
note.zh: 将 Bengio 首创的生成式搜索框架 GFlowNets 用于设计真正可合成的类药分子。

title.en: Frontier AI Auditing: Toward Rigorous Third-Party Assessment of Safety and Security Practices at Leading AI Companies
title.zh: Frontier AI Auditing: Toward Rigorous Third-Party Assessment of Safety and Security Practices at Leading AI Companies

note.en: A large multi-author proposal, signed by Bengio, for how independent third parties could rigorously audit the safety and security claims of frontier AI companies.
note.zh: 一份由 Bengio 参与署名的多作者提案，论述独立第三方应如何严格审计前沿人工智能公司的安全与保障承诺。

title.en: Discrete Feynman-Kac Correctors
title.zh: Discrete Feynman-Kac Correctors

note.en: Extends Feynman-Kac correctors to discrete diffusion models, improving sampling from discrete sequence generators; joint with Alán Aspuru-Guzik and Kirill Neklyudov.
note.zh: 将 Feynman-Kac 校正子推广到离散扩散模型，改善离散序列生成的采样质量；与 Alán Aspuru-Guzik、Kirill Neklyudov 合作完成。

title.en: In-Context Reinforcement Learning through Bayesian Fusion of Context and Value Prior
title.zh: In-Context Reinforcement Learning through Bayesian Fusion of Context and Value Prior

note.en: With David Rolnick, fuses in-context evidence with a learned value prior so in-context RL can improve beyond its training distribution.
note.zh: 与 David Rolnick 合作，将上下文证据与学到的价值先验融合，使上下文强化学习能够突破训练分布的限制。

title.en: A Comedy of Estimators: On KL Regularization in RL Training of LLMs
title.zh: A Comedy of Estimators: On KL Regularization in RL Training of LLMs

note.en: A Mila study with Aaron Courville and Pablo Samuel Castro of how the choice of KL estimator changes the outcome of reinforcement-learning training for LLMs.
note.zh: 与 Aaron Courville、Pablo Samuel Castro 合作的 Mila 研究，分析 KL 估计量的选择如何改变大模型强化学习训练的结果。

title.en: The Future of the AI Summit Series
title.zh: The Future of the AI Summit Series

note.en: A policy memo Bengio co-signed on where the international AI Summit series should go after Bletchley, Seoul and Paris.
note.zh: Bengio 联署的一份政策备忘录，讨论国际人工智能峰会系列在布莱切利、首尔和巴黎之后应走向何方。

title.en: Creator of AI: We Have 2 Years Before Everything Changes! These Jobs Won't Exist in 24 Months!
title.zh: Creator of AI: We Have 2 Years Before Everything Changes! These Jobs Won't Exist in 24 Months!

posts.source: The Diary Of A CEO with Steven Bartlett

note.en: Bengio appeared on The Diary Of A CEO to warn about the dangers of agentic AI and the urgent need to build AI that won't harm people.
note.zh: 本吉奥做客The Diary Of A CEO播客，警示智能体AI的危险，并强调必须尽快构建不会伤害人类的AI。

title.en: Sliding Window Recurrences for Sequence Models
title.zh: Sliding Window Recurrences for Sequence Models

note.en: A hierarchical decomposition of linear recurrences for multi-hybrid sequence architectures, with Michael Poli and Stefano Massaroli.
note.zh: 与 Michael Poli、Stefano Massaroli 合作，为多重混合序列架构提出线性递归的分层分解方法。

title.en: International AI Safety Report 2025: Second Key Update: Technical Safeguards and Risk Management
title.zh: International AI Safety Report 2025: Second Key Update: Technical Safeguards and Risk Management

note.en: Contributed to the International AI Safety Report 2025 Second Key Update on technical safeguards and risk management, the report he chairs.
note.zh: 参与其主持的《国际人工智能安全报告2025》第二次关键更新，聚焦技术防护措施与风险管理。

title.en: A HOT Dataset: 150,000 Buildings for HVAC Operations Transfer Research
title.zh: A HOT Dataset: 150,000 Buildings for HVAC Operations Transfer Research

note.en: Co-authored a large building-operations dataset (150,000 buildings) for transfer-learning research on HVAC systems, part of Mila's climate/energy-efficiency ML work.
note.zh: 合著论文发布一个包含15万栋建筑的数据集，用于HVAC系统的迁移学习研究，属于Mila气候与能效相关的机器学习工作。

title.en: Identifying indicators of consciousness in AI systems
title.zh: Identifying indicators of consciousness in AI systems

note.en: Co-authored a Trends in Cognitive Sciences paper proposing indicators for assessing consciousness in AI systems.
note.zh: 合著论文发表于《认知科学趋势》，提出评估AI系统意识的指标框架。

title.en: Deep-learning-based virtual screening of antibacterial compounds
title.zh: Deep-learning-based virtual screening of antibacterial compounds

note.en: Co-authored Nature Biotechnology paper on deep-learning-based virtual screening for new antibacterial compounds.
note.zh: 合著《自然·生物技术》论文，介绍基于深度学习的抗菌化合物虚拟筛选方法。

title.en: A Definition of AGI
title.zh: A Definition of AGI

note.en: Co-authored a proposed formal definition of artificial general intelligence, aiming to ground AGI debates in measurable criteria.
note.zh: 合著论文提出通用人工智能（AGI）的正式定义，力图为AGI讨论建立可衡量的标准。

title.en: Navigating ternary doping in Li-ion cathodes with closed-loop multi-objective Bayesian optimization
title.zh: Navigating ternary doping in Li-ion cathodes with closed-loop multi-objective Bayesian optimization

note.en: Co-authored work applying closed-loop, multi-objective Bayesian optimization to design ternary-doped lithium-ion battery cathodes.
note.zh: 合著论文将闭环多目标贝叶斯优化应用于三元掺杂锂离子电池正极材料设计。

title.en: International AI Safety Report 2025: First Key Update: Capabilities and Risk Implications
title.zh: International AI Safety Report 2025: First Key Update: Capabilities and Risk Implications

note.en: Contributed to the International AI Safety Report 2025 First Key Update on frontier AI capabilities and risk implications, the report he chairs.
note.zh: 参与其主持的《国际人工智能安全报告2025》首次关键更新，评估前沿AI能力与风险影响。

title.en: Illusions of AI consciousness
title.zh: Illusions of AI consciousness

note.en: Co-authored a Science paper examining why AI systems can create illusory impressions of consciousness.
note.zh: 合著《科学》期刊论文，探讨AI系统为何会造成意识的错觉。

title.en: Introducing LawZero
title.zh: Introducing LawZero

note.en: Bengio's own announcement of LawZero, the non-profit AI safety research organisation he founded to put safety ahead of commercial pressure.
note.zh: Bengio 亲自宣布创立非营利人工智能安全研究机构 LawZero，宗旨是让安全优先于商业压力。

title.en: The catastrophic risks of AI — and a safer path | Yoshua Bengio
title.zh: The catastrophic risks of AI — and a safer path | Yoshua Bengio

note.en: Bengio's TED talk laying out the catastrophic risks he sees on the current AI trajectory and the safer, non-agentic alternative he proposes.
note.zh: Bengio 的 TED 演讲，阐述他在当前人工智能发展轨迹中看到的灾难性风险，以及他提出的更安全的非能动性替代路径。

title.en: Yoshua Bengio - Designing out Agency for Safe AI
title.zh: Yoshua Bengio - Designing out Agency for Safe AI

note.en: An MLST technical interview in which Bengio explains why designing agency out of AI systems is his proposed route to safety.
note.zh: MLST 的技术访谈，Bengio 解释为何他把「从 AI 系统中去掉能动性」作为通往安全的路径。

title.en: Implications of Artificial General Intelligence on National and International Security
